About this project

Lexus is a colour-change project: the visible colour of this Lexus was changed with cast vinyl film instead of paint. The factory paint stays underneath, protected from stone chips and UV, and the film can be removed later if you want the original colour back.

We work with colour-change films from 3M, Avery Dennison and other leading brands in gloss, satin, matte, metallic and colour-shift finishes. The car is washed and decontaminated first, and handles, lights and trim are removed where needed so the film tucks behind the edges instead of being cut on the panel. The wrap is applied panel by panel in our climate-controlled bay in Vaughan and is backed by our 5-year workmanship warranty against lifting and peeling.

Thinking about a new colour? Try films on your type of vehicle in the car wrap visualizer, compare finishes on our colour change wraps page, read how long a wrap lasts in a Canadian winter or see vehicle wraps in Vaughan.
